description: Spend stress to reduce a consequence. Roll ability to potentially reduce cost. Base cost by severity defaults to Minor=1, Moderate=2, Severe=3 (the world's stressConfig can change them). Pass `damage` when the consequence is HP damage — the tool then applies the mechanical effect itself (successful resist halves it, failed resist lands in full; set `alreadyApplied` if the damage already hit HP so it refunds the reduction). Returns an envelope with `outcome` ('reduced', 'absorbed', or 'trauma_gained') and a one-line `summary` as the headline; stress/trauma/HP changes in `state_delta`. Not available in worlds that don't spend stress (mechanics.fitd.stressSpends).

consequence.description: Description of the consequence being resisted

damage.description: Mechanical damage consequence. When provided the tool applies the resist result to HP itself: a successful resist halves the damage (rounded down — 1 becomes 0), a failed resist lets it land in full. Without this, the resist is stress-only and any mechanical effect is the GM's to apply.

alreadyApplied.description: True when the damage already hit the character's HP (e.g. a preceding attack envelope applied it) — the tool then refunds the reduction instead of applying the remainder. In worlds with Health and Wounds a Wound can't be refunded: resist before the damage lands.

amount.description: HP damage of the consequence being resisted

damageType.description: Kind of damage, for the wound table in worlds with Health and Wounds

resistAbility.description: Ability id to roll for potential cost reduction, from the session's world (the default world: STR, AGI, WIT, CON)

severity.description: Severity of consequence to resist (affects stress cost)

name: resist_consequence
